# Recorded Scenario MCP replies

Recorded from the hosted Scenario MCP (server 0.34.0) on 2026-10-18 with free calls only (schema reads, dry runs, a free upload), then scrubbed: ids, signed links and account fields are replaced with placeholders. Job rows are shaped from real replies with placeholder ids. The Meshy 7.1 Image to 3D and Tripo P2 schemas were recorded on 2026-10-19, unchanged (they hold no ids).

`tests/fake_backend/fake_scenario.py` serves them; `tools/contract_check.py` checks weekly that the live server still answers this way.
